question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank. His best friend _______ (disclose) his business secrets in the press conference.
solution: The correct answer is **'revealed.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Disclose means to make (secret or new information) known. (गुप्त या नई जानकारी का खुलासा करना।) • Example Sentence: The scientist disclosed his revolutionary new discovery to the world. • Revealed also refers to the act of making previously unknown or secret information known. (अज्ञात या गुप्त जानकारी का खुलासा करना।) • Example Sentence: She revealed the truth about her past to her family. **Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Deceived: Mislead or trick someone. (किसी को भ्रमित करना, धोखा देना।) • Concealed: Kept secret; hidden. (गुप्त रखना; छिपाना।) • Superseded: Take the place of (a person or thing previously in authority or use); supplant.
